Name: fashion sense plague doctor mask
Author: apolloschaos
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
i liked the look of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7670]plague doctor mask[/url] by freakshowflesh but it would not show up in my game as that creator intended, even with all the dependencies and such. I figured out how to get it to work by using the png asset from the original (with minor edits) and editing the example content pack from Fashion Sense. 

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
1) download 
2) unzip
3) add to your mods folder


[line]
note: if you are the original creator and would like this taken down, message me. You haven't replied to any posts on the mod since 2021.
